case_selection.selection_rule: Include every test row whose dataset class has an exact registered fault mapping. Pair each fault row with its frozen nominal counterpart. No post-result case removal is allowed.

statistics.multiple_comparison_policy: Full-stack engineering promotion uses A2 vs A0. Probe formal-evidence-producer review uses the separately preregistered A2 vs A7 estimand. Other ablations remain descriptive and may not be substituted post hoc.
statistics.precision_policy: No retrospective power claim is accepted. Promotion requires the preregistered independent-group count and 95% effect-interval half-width gates. If precision is inadequate, expand independent groups under a new preregistered campaign; do not delete cases or alter thresholds after results are observed.
statistics.minimum_effect_rationale: The 0.15 equal-group accuracy-difference floor is frozen before real execution and approximately preserves the practical magnitude implied by the prior design's first significance-clearing all-benefit pattern (6 one-direction discordances among at most 38 independent groups ~= 0.158). It is an engineering review floor, not a flight-calibrated utility threshold.

claim_boundary: Frozen engineering confirmatory design with group-aware inference. Passing full-stack gates authorizes engineering promotion review only. Passing the separate A2-vs-A7 probe estimand only authorizes an independent Probe formal-evidence-producer review; neither result establishes flight qualification, safety certification, or generalization outside the frozen datasets.
